distribution.narrative: Accepted for Taiwan from Beaver & Liu (2010), which treats Cosmoderes attenuatus as a first Taiwan record. Reported Taiwan localities are Ilan (Fushan) and Nantou (Tsuifeng).

host_note: Exact host species Actinidia polygama, Akebia trifoliata and Stauntonia hexaphylla are reported from Japan in Beaver & Liu (2010). The source explicitly states that the host is unknown in Taiwan; these hosts must not be represented as Taiwan host records.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cosmoderes attenuatus (Nobuchi, 1981).

taxonomic_history.name: Cosmoderes attenuatus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cosmoderes attenuatus (Nobuchi, 1981), VSN_1604. Beaver & Liu (2010) treats C. attenuatus as distinct from C. monilicollis despite earlier proposed synonymy.
